# M1

> Every page of the M1 module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [M1 ABHA identity](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1): M1 base URLs and the operations grouped by use case.
- [M1 APIs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/apis): The rules that hold across every M1 endpoint. Base URLs, how scope picks the job, RSA encryption, and the two token rule.
- [Find the Aadhaar number behind an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-find-aadhaar-by-abha): The reverse lookup. It returns a national identity number, so treat both the request and the response as sensitive and log neither.
- [Find an ABHA number from an Aadhaar number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-find-abha-by-aadhaar): A benefit scheme lookup, not a general search. The Aadhaar value is encrypted.
- [Get the benefit record for an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-get-by-abha): Reads the benefit record attached to one ABHA number.
- [Get the state and district recorded against an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-get-state-district): Used to route a person to the right scheme, since eligibility is often decided by where they live.
- [Link or unlink a benefit record from an ABHA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-link-or-delink): One call does both directions. The success response names the scheme and confirms the link in a human readable status string rather than a code, so match on...
- [Search benefit records for a person](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-search): Searches by encrypted XML UID or by ABHA number, depending on loginHint. Returns an array, one entry per benefit scheme, each with the scheme name, its...
- [Find insurance cover recorded against an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-search-insurance): Documented responses include 400, 401 and 500 as well as 200. Handle all four.
- [Download PHR Card](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-download-phr-card): Download the PHR / ABHA Address card image.
- [Download PHR QR Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-download-phr-qr-code): Download the PHR QR code image. Schema and examples are in this specification.
- [Encrypt a value with the ABDM public key](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-encrypt-value): Every loginId in M1 is encrypted rather than sent raw, and this is the hosted helper for doing it. It is convenient for trying a flow by hand.
- [Get suggested ABHA addresses for a new account](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-address-suggestions): Returns a handful of available ABHA addresses built from the person's name and date of birth. Offer them as a choice. The person may type their own instead,...
- [Create an ABHA from a verified Aadhaar OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-by-aadhaar): Exchanges the OTP you just received for a real ABHA number. Send the txnId from the OTP request, the encrypted OTP value, and the consent block recording...
- [Create an ABHA from an identity document](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-by-document): The route for somebody who cannot complete Aadhaar authentication. A driving licence is one accepted document. The account created this way is restricted...
- [Submit a captured biometric or face authentication block](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-capture-pid): Hands over the PID block produced by the Aadhaar RD service. The block is encrypted by the device and is time limited, so send it as soon as the capture...
- [Claim a chosen ABHA address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-claim-abha-address): Attaches the address the person picked to the ABHA number created earlier. preferred: 1 marks it as the one to show.
- [Start face or biometric authentication and get a transaction id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-face-auth-init): Returns the txnId that a QR code is built from. The person scans that QR with the ABHA app, completes face authentication through the Aadhaar RD service,...
- [List the child ABHA accounts linked to this account](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-list-children): A parent or guardian can hold ABHA accounts for children under their own account. This returns them.
- [Send an OTP to begin or continue an enrolment](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-request-otp): The first call of most enrolment flows, and the one people reuse without noticing. What it does depends on scope and loginHint.
- [Verify an OTP that ABDM sent, during enrolment](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-enrolment-verify-abdm-otp): Confirms the mobile number or email address the person gave during enrolment. The OTP here came from ABDM rather than from Aadhaar, which is why the call is...
- [Find an ABHA for somebody who does not know theirs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-find-abha-search): Takes an encrypted mobile number, Aadhaar number or biometric result and sends an OTP to the mobile on record. The response carries a txnId and a message...
- [Get PHR Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-get-phr-profile): Retrieve the authenticated user's PHR profile after ABHA Address login.
- [Get RSA Public Certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-get-public-certificate): Fetch the RSA public key used to encrypt all sensitive fields before transmission. Fields requiring encryption: Aadhaar, Mobile, OTP, Password, ABHA Number,...
- [Send a login OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-request-otp): Starts a login. loginHint selects what the person is identifying themselves with: mobile, aadhaar or abha-number. As everywhere in M1, loginId is encrypted...
- [Send a login OTP, v3.1](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-request-otp-v31): The v3.1 variant of the login OTP request. It sits on a different base path from the rest of M1, /abha/api/v3.1 rather than /abha/api/v3, which is why the...
- [Search ABHA Profile (for Password Login)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-search): Look up a profile by ABHA Number as the first step of the password login flow. Returns basic profile info to confirm the correct account before requesting...
- [Choose which ABHA to sign in to](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-select-account): Used when one mobile number carries several ABHA accounts, which is common in a family. Send the txnId from the verify call and the ABHA number the person...
- [Verify a login OTP and get a user token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-verify): Returns the user scoped token that profile calls need, sent afterwards as the X-token header. That token identifies one person, so it is not interchangeable...
- [Verify a login OTP, v3.1](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-verify-v31): The v3.1 counterpart of the login verification, on the /abha/api/v3.1 base path.
- [Send Share Acknowledgement (HIP → Gateway)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-on-share-acknowledgement): HIP sends an acknowledgement back to the ABDM Gateway after receiving and processing the patient's shared profile. Typically includes a token/queue number...
- [Send OTP for ABHA Address Login](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-phr-request-otp): Send OTP to login via ABHA Address.
- [Search ABHA Address, Get Auth Methods](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-phr-search-abha-address): Look up available authentication methods for a given ABHA Address before login.
- [Verify OTP / Biometric for ABHA Address Login](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-phr-verify): Complete the ABHA Address login with OTP or biometric.
- [Download the ABHA card as a file](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-download-abha-card): The same card, delivered as a downloadable file rather than for inline display.
- [Get the ABHA card](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-get-abha-card): The card as an image, for display inside your application.
- [Read the signed in person's ABHA profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-get-account): Needs the X-token from login, because it reads one person's account rather than anything about your application.
- [Get the ABHA QR code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-get-qr-code): The QR a person shows at a facility so their ABHA address can be read without typing. Returns the image payload for the signed in account.
- [Log the person out and invalidate their user token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-logout): Invalidates the X-token. Call it when the person signs out, and when your session ends, so a token cannot outlive the session that produced it.
- [Send an OTP to change something on the profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-request-otp): Raise this before updating a mobile number, an email address or a password. scope names both the area and the action, for example [\
- [Update fields on an ABHA profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-update-account): Changes self declared profile details. Changing a mobile number or an email address is not done here: those need the OTP pair below, because NHA verifies...
- [Verify the OTP for a profile change](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-verify-otp): Completes the change the OTP was raised for. Send the same scope you used when requesting it, along with the txnId and the encrypted OTP.
- [Receive a patient's shared profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-receive-patient-share): Also known as: [HIP Callback] Receive Patient Profile Share. This endpoint is implemented by the HIP, the ABDM Gateway forwards the patient's profile to the...
- [Register / Update HIP-HIU Services (Facility Registry)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-register-hrp-services): Register or update HIP/HIU services in the Facility Registry. Must be called after updating the bridge URL. Server: https://facilitysbx.abdm.gov.in
- [Send Email Verification Link](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-send-email-verification-link): Send a one-click email verification link. The user clicks it to verify their email, no OTP required.
- [Get a new user token from a refresh token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-token-refresh): Refreshes the X-token without making the person log in again. Read the expiry from the response rather than assuming one.
- [M1 ABHA identity errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/errors): What M1 ABHA identity returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
